description: PUT /v2/vendors/{vendor_id} declares an empty parameter list despite its path variable. Restore the required string vendor_id path declaration, matching GET on the same path and the previously reviewed import, with update-specific wording. POST /oauth2/revoke declares oauth2 scopes as null; replace only that invalid scope list with [] as required by OpenAPI. Assert complete original lists and each operation's identity/tags. Known upstream references to missing CurrencyExchange and AppFeeAllocation schemas remain unresolved; no schemas are invented.
